about: Interleaved A/B time to first playable on /play: the same sentences and shared games on two servers, runs paired back to back. Method: evals/play/first-playable/README.md.
sentences: A space marine shoots alien bugs in a mining colony
A knight must collect three keys in a haunted castle while dodging ghosts.
a stunt race where a monster truck jumps over ramps and smashes through stacks of crates on the way to the finish line
a first-person ride in a mine cart on rails, turning to shoot the bats that swoop at you in the dark tunnels
run a burger shop for one shift: place grills and counters on the grid, spend coins and serve every customer before closing time
